messages:
maria: Heads up — after we enabled cross-region fallback for EU->US yesterday, p99 for seq_len=512 workloads spiked during peak. Baseline p99 ~85ms, saw bursts up to 330ms. Logs point to KV cache misses on fallback path. Snapshot: p50=22ms p95=56ms p99=330ms :warning: Anyone on perf?
arjun: I saw the alert. Confirmed increased tail on prod-runtime. Initial theory: fallback triggers cold KV cache + different kernel selection on US nodes causing longer init. Looking at profiling now.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1457 — p99 spike during cross-region fallback. Pager duty notified.
ken: Can you paste profiler output? microbatch settings? We recently increased microbatch_size to 8 for throughput.
maria: microbatch=8 on canary, target latency SLO 150ms. We thought batching would help but p99 worse. Trying with microbatch=4 reduces p99 to ~120ms but throughput drops ~18%.
arjun: Profiling snippet:
```
# perf trace - region fallback trace
seq=512 model=redwood-v1 quant=8bit
kernel_select: attention=fast_attention_v2 (fallback) -> init_ms=42
kv_cache: hit_rate=0.62 miss_cost_avg=24ms tail=78ms
microbatch=8 -> queue_wait_avg=12ms
microbatch=4 -> queue_wait_avg=6ms
```
It shows kernel init cost + KV miss tail dominating p99.
nick: Could be we pick different CUDA kernel variants based on available SM count; US pool uses older driver so selects 'attention_v2' not 'attention_v3'. That kernel has slower cold path. Roll drivers?
maria: Driver diff is plausible. Also noticed routing waterfall: requests rerouted to US cause KV cache cold start for that customer and they get tail. We should consider sticky routing for warm caches.
ken: Tradeoffs: sticky routing reduces throughput flexibility and can cause hotspots. Alternatively, warm-kv-prefetch on fallback candidate before actually serving could hide miss cost.
arjun: Quick experiment results: microbatch=4 + prefetch on fallback reduces p99 to ~110ms on canary. Throughput drop of ~12% vs baseline microbatch=8. p95 unaffected.
maria: Notes: - Kernel switch to attention_v3 on US nodes dropped init_ms from 42->10 but still kv miss tail exists. - Prefetch reduces miss_cost_avg to 6ms.
ops-bot: deploy-log: canary/2026-03-17T11:24:00 -> prefetched-fallback-enabled
nick: Suggestion: Add route policy: prefer same-region, but if fallback needed, async-prefetch KV and serve from warm path if available within X ms else fallback to local smaller batch. Also consider lowering microbatch for latency-sensitive customers via config.
maria: Agreed. Action items: @arjun patch runtime prefetch; @ken test kernel driver bump in staging; @nick add sticky-routing experiment and per-customer microbatch override. I'll update INC-2026-1457 with these notes.
arjun: I'll open PR with perf numbers attached.
sre-bot: update: INC-2026-1457 updated by maria
